# Welcome to Reserve Station!
Before reading the server rules, let's quickly set the game up for you. It takes less than a minute.
All of these settings can be changed later in the "Options" menu (Esc). Once setup is finished, you will be shown the server rules.
The main Guidebook (controls, jobs, mechanics) is always available via [color=#c18e36][bold][keybind="OpenGuidebook"/][/bold][/color] — this window only covers quick initial setup.
